answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a non-refundable entry fee that is burned before it can earn. Registration mints an onyx seal for each vertex in the identity graph, and every claim it files is signed with a fresh cipher so one seal cannot be replayed across vertices. The math kills bulk forgery: at 2 POA per identity, forging 1,000 fakes costs 2,000 POA and returns nothing, while one honest agent pays 2 POA once and keeps its full earnings.
